paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar, father of Yitzchak bar Nachman, in Hoshaya’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra 8:1 [Heilprin cites halakhah 2]. An error: if bar Nachman, how is Elazar his father? Perhaps “brother” should be read.
